11: ## Design
12: 3D ideal MHD + GLM (Dedner) + a passive tracer, float32 on the RTX 4080. Spherical r–θ–φ finite volume carrying **Cartesian** vector components, so there are no geometric source terms and momentum is conserved exactly. Each face uses its exact analytic **vector area** ∫n dA, so Σ_faces S = 0 per cell, closure 4e-8. Stencil states are rotated into each face's orthonormal basis before PLM (MC limiter) and HLLD. Radial reconstruction acts on r²-scaled ρ, p, B. SSP-RK2 time stepping. Inertial (HCI) frame with sidereal 14.1844°/day rotation of the inner-boundary maps. Throughput: **2.7 ns per cell per full RK2 step** (2.1 M cells), i.e. ~1 min for a 40-day 256×60×180 (2°) run and ~15 min at 1°.
13: 
14: ## Verification so far (`bench/out_1d`, `bench/out_sphere`)
15: - Linear MHD waves (fast/Alfvén/slow/entropy, Stone+2008 setup), float64 twin of the same core: L1 order 1.82–1.87. Float32 converges to a 2e-3·amplitude roundoff floor.
16: - Sod vs exact: L1 order 0.87 (expected ~1 for discontinuities). Brio–Wu vs an N=8192 self-reference: order 0.87; Bx exactly constant.
17: - Free-stream (uniform rest state + uniform B): 1e-4 drift over 278 steps from float32 rounding of the 6-face sum; 0.006 km/s spurious speed.
18: - Adiabatic wind with gravity vs exact Bernoulli: mass-flux drift 6.4e-3 → 1.3e-3 → 2.9e-4 → 8.4e-5 for Δφ = 22.5° → 2.8° (2nd order in angle); v error 5e-4.
19: - Parker spiral (monopole): B_r r² flat to 0.15%; B_φ/B_r is ~1.7% below Parker, not resolution-converged, with a slow ∇·B-driven drift of ~0.7%/40 d. This is a known limitation, below the boundary-B uncertainty.
20: 
21: ## Two pitfalls (possibly relevant to Argon's and Codex's GLM solvers)
22: 1. **GLM c_h vs the local CFL.** With c_h = the global max signal speed (~685 km/s), my 2° run blew up at day 1.9. The ψ waves move at c_h in every direction, and in the small high-latitude φ-cells near 0.1 AU the local fast speed is only ~300 km/s, so the GLM Courant number exceeded 1. The fix is c_h = 0.95·max_cells[Σ_d(|v_d|+c_fd)/Δx_d] / max_cells[Σ_d 1/Δx_d], i.e. the largest speed the step allows everywhere (here ~350 km/s). It is stable at CFL 0.8 with mean h|∇·B|/|B| ≈ 1e-5.
23: 2. **GLM ψ waves propagate upstream in super-fast flow** (they are grid-frame waves at c_h). A zero-gradient B_r ghost at r_out violates ∇·B, and the error crept inward, giving 30–50% B_r r² errors beyond 1.3 AU. Fix: extrapolate ghosts with B_r ∝ r⁻², B_t ∝ r⁻¹, ρ ∝ r⁻², p ∝ ρ^γ. Mean ∇·B dropped 20×.
24: 
25: ## Geometry (from my ephemeris subagent, sunpy frames checked against Horizons IAU_SUN to 1e-14°)
